caption:
Anthropic just revealed how its own marketing team is using Claude — and it shows what AI-powered marketing workflows could look like.

The team has connected Claude to Google Ads, where it can analyze search terms, identify irrelevant keywords, suggest negative keywords, and recommend campaign optimizations.
They’ve also connected Claude to Gmail so important emails can be summarized and turned into a clear priority list each morning.

And with marketing dashboards connected, Claude can help keep reports updated automatically so the team can spend more time on decisions instead of repetitive reporting.

The bigger takeaway?

AI doesn’t have to replace your marketing team.

It can replace repetitive work and give people more time for strategy, creativity, and higher-value decisions.

If more companies adopt workflows like these, AI could become less of a chatbot and more of an always-on marketing operator.
